items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I played in the Kid House's band for about three or four years. Eddie, Eddie, Eddie used to play bass horn. [INTERVIEWER] We used to play with the Kid House... Kid Harris, and I've heard it, yeah.

ctx.x: I remember one for a parade. He prayed when he came back in California. And he gave him some buzzing breeze for about two weeks. You remember that parade? Yes, indeed. You remember that parade? He was doing up for about two weeks. I don't think he wanted any more after that. I was used to walking in that.

We used to play with the Kid House. And drum, drum, drum. Yeah, he was playing in the Kid House's band too, right? Kid Harris, and I've heard it, yeah. I played in the Kid House's band for about three or four years. Eddie, Eddie, Eddie used to play bass horn.
Did you say you played bass horn too?
